text_block_list.text:
One day, together with two of her juniors, 
I went to shop for training gear chosen by 
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This brand offers UV protection, plus it's 
highly functional and looks super stylish♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Until now, I just picked them based 
on whether the color was cute or whatever 
fit my budget.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"A guide is essential when traversing an 
unfamiliar path"... Thank you very much 
for teaching me so kindly.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Something like this is an absolute 
breeze♪ Feel free to ask me anytime♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You're right. Let's head to the store!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Are we having lunch at the food court 
today? Wow, there are so many 
restaurants!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There are Japanese food and sweet shops 
too? ♪ You really took our preferences 
into consideration, didn't you~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad you liked it♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? That's...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Look, they're selling the tiramisu from 
that shop I went to when I was little!

The shop's sign read, 'Youth Haven ☆ 
Bubbly Deluxe'.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This is the shop my mom took me to on the 
way back from a Harajuku boutique long 
ago...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's even a banner that says 
"Hokkaido Melons"!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In addition to tiramisu, it looks like 
they have prosciutto with melon and other 
party-worthy menu items.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A party, you say!? What an enchanting 
sound that is!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'm missing this! I'm gonna 
party all out today!
choice_data_list:
Get out there and give it everything 
you've got!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'm missing this! I'm gonna 
party all out today!
choice_data_list:
Get out there and give it everything 
you've got!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! I-I know. But after I went through 
the trouble of finding it...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, why don't we share a bit with 
everyone? I want everyone to taste how 
super amazing this is!"

We all moved to a new spot and decided to 
share the food everyone bought.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Hokkaido melon and cheese— it's 
wicked nostalgic and delicious, eh~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Learn from the past to understand the 
new"... Blending Japanese and Western 
styles is a Japanese tradition too, isn't 
it~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, totally super-duper good♪ I'm so glad 
everyone got to taste it too♪

And so, Maruzensky and the others enjoyed 
their meal, even with the reduced 
calories.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"That's the spirit! Everyone, let's eat 
our hearts out today!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's-a-go!

We all moved to a new spot and decided to 
share the food everyone bought.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Delicious~! I'm gonna go full throttle and 
conquer every single flavor! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The sea urchin, crab, and shrimp are all 
wicked delicious! Who'd have thought you 
could get an all-you-can-eat in Tokyo!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The large tiered bento box is packed with 
delicious dishes...! Today is truly a 
special day of celebration♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Today is "Memory Flavor 
Anniversary"☆ Mmm, it's cho-very-good♪

Maruzensky and the others ate their fill 
of party food.
